meta.title: Creative studio
meta.description: Start from one line of idea or a whole script: a director agent reads it, fills the brief itself and asks only a few questions with recommended answers, then the line runs — creative ideas → story → storyboard (13 deterministic shot-contract gates) → six-dimension characters → voice plan → segment rendering → final cut. A producer agent writes, an editorial team agent cuts, a reviewer agent scores every stage; failures are reworked automatically and anything still failing stops for your review.
